notes.title: Updating some things..
notes.content:
Our game has sat with updates to be done, and models to be made for a little while now. With the loss of most of the team, it is possible that we may have to discontinue services. We will be trying to get the game to a fully playable state with improved gameplay and grafix; but will be dropping the multiplayer and second story. We may approach the multiplayer again at some point; but for now, we will be removing the multiplayer to focus fully on the main story and gameplay.

Thank you for your support.

notes.title: New update to progress, and other things.
notes.content:
We are at a loss with the loss of our main programmer and have begun to change to the Unreal 4 engine instead if we can. We will do what we can to update you guys. We also have gotten our hands on a nice MoCap system so we can tweek our animations a bit more.

The game has been a long and challenging one for us, but we hope to have everything ready for you soon! Stay tuned for more.

notes.title: Crashing concerns, and other updates
notes.content:
We seemed to have resolved most if not all of the crashing concerns for the game. We will be posting a few new updated screen shots and video once able. We also are going to be pushing another update as soon as we can. We would like to say farewell to one of our team as they have pulled out of the work to focus on other projects. 

With this loss, updates will continue but may not be as big as the last 2 have been (more level and sound updates coming for the next update). 

We have resovled the spawning concerns on our systems, and are waiting to hear back from testers on if the concerns continue for them. 

We plan on having all the levels in the game for testers soon, as well as soon after that out to the public!

notes.title: Quick patch
notes.content:
We have done a quick patch fixing some launching, though this has now caused our launch Icon to change. Some other issues have been fixed in regards to some sounds and spawning.

Known issues

-4th level doors do not all function (Should be resolved within the next day)
-Some texturing is not placing properly
-Some sounds are not firing correct que (working on fix)
-Player sounds no longer functioning (being fixed as we post)
-AI may be looped in a pattern (may revert to primitve AI until fixed)
-Cutscenes not triggering (Will re-render cutscenes to fix concern)
-Pause menu not working (May revert to old Pause until fixed)
-Save and Load not working (still working on this)

If you continue to have crashing or launching concerns, please contact us at morphodox@hotmail.com to advise us what point the crash happens and the error code provided. If the concern presists we will go back to find another patch fix for this. 

Next update should be a fix of more concerns as well as ensuring that the maps have all the items and sound ques in them. We are also trying to get the first few areas of the Second story with it (though with bug fixes this may not be in this update).

Thank you!

notes.title: A long silence to be broken!
notes.content:
The game work has been dragging on with every update to our beta systems. New levels filled with new and remade models, new animations, new voice acting, new animations, new menus, and the second story line all making a splash in the beta. Continual errors and changes drag the release of the game further and further, while the ones working on the game have their own lives taking time away from the develeopment.

We promise no time of the release of our long awated big update, but be asured it is coming and we are working as hard as we can on making sure it is finished. 

We will in the near future have videos and ther things showing the changes of the game. 

Be warned, even after testing as we have, the update may be rough (bugs and glitches). Once the update is released, we WILL be pushing to smooth out the bugs and get to final release!

notes.title: Slightly Longer process than imagined...
notes.content:
We have continued to update everything as much as possible, a few errors have come up. We will put the update out as planned, though it may not be as fullfilled as we had hoped it to be. It will have the Levels and creatures in it, a few of the cutscenes, and a few of the new sounds and voice acting (but not all of them). The menus are almost finished up, though we have been mostly focusing on the newest version of the maps. The update is slated for 2 weeks, and we plan on posting a few things before that update to show a few things. For those who want to play micro versions before the release, simply ask about joining the patch testing. With everything on this update, we are going to cram as much into it as possible, though we cannot garantee all bugs will be worked out or levels being fully completed (filled with objects).


Thank you all - William

notes.title: New cinematic and previews of beta build coming.
notes.content:
We have been working dilegantly on fixing up the game and adjusting things that have been found wrong with it by players. We hope to have a full revamp of the game out in a matter of weeks (a remade version of the original story and more of the secondary story finished). At the moment we have been forced to retract the last patch as it was to unstable and people were unable to play the game at all. 

We have fixed that portion of the patch on our end, and will be releasing that patch with extra content added into the game as soon as we can. We would also like to welcome our new programmer into the project who will be adjusting the ai coding as well as some other coding to improve gameplay.

We will attempt to keep everyone posted with news on a weekly basis from here on out until the game is in a fully playable state once more and the patch is released. 

If there is anything that players have found in the game once that patch comes out, we will be listening to try and fix any concerns (bugs, glitches, crashes ect..) as soon as we can and re-patch with micro patches.

notes.title: 2 new screen shots, more to come over the next few days!
notes.content: We hope to be able to upload at least 2 new photos every day up to the patch to show a few of the visual changes for the patch, and will continue after the patch to show as we do more! The 2 we have uploaded are a new version of the lamp and a bit of environment textures with new remade higher poly count models! More to come as we are approaching our Monday/Tuesday patch. We will continue from there making smaller patches as we update content and add new content! With each patch we hope to add at least 1 level (though this may change based on frequency of patches), and several remade models!

notes.title: Delayed patch and a few new items to the game.
notes.content: We missed our patch deadline to focus on bug fixes and a general revamp of the original story mode. Currently we have added and fixed several models and textures, are trying to update the pause menu to be more fluid and look more presentable. There will be more screenshots showing the difference between the original version of the game and the revamped models and textures. There will be a patch late Monday June 1st or early Tuesday June 2nd with the first level of the second story mode (rough and a bit buggy), a new menu area (keeping the walk around menu), and adjusted models and textures for the main story. The co-op is still in the works, though our main attentions have been moved to the second story mode and adjusting the main story mode. We hope to have the original story mode revamped within the next month or so and the second story mode ground work finished by roughly the same time (not including bug fixes and graphical updates). The co-op will be more touch and go as we go along. We will work on it, and try to integrate steam workshop (so players can add their own nightmares or simply goof around with their friends). Stay tuned as we continue this journey.
